name: Q&A Composite
description: Composite of six LLM judges (groundedness, response completeness, relevance, similarity, coherence, fluency) and the code-based F1 score, weighted into an aggregate Q&A quality score.

expectedInputs.description: Reference answer, from EvalInput.GroundTruth, for similarity and F1. Without one those two parts are not measured and the composite cannot pass: it withholds its pass (warn), naming them, unless a measured part fails it.
